page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.r8ae.4xlarge demonstrates top-tier single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench text processing scores placing in the top 10%. Single-core Geekbench scores and PassMark memory scores are strong, ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core performance metrics, such as stress-ng multi-core CPU, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores, fall within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests show average throughput, with cached small-block reads reaching 1232.18 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads at 49.58 GB/sec.

The instance offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient choice for applications requiring substantial memory capacity without the overhead of local storage or GPU hardware. However, the lack of bundled local storage means all storage operations must traverse the network, which may limit performance for I/O-heavy database workloads. Given its high memory-to-core ratio and strong single-core performance, the ecs.r8ae.4xlarge is well-suited for memory-intensive applications, in-memory databases, text processing pipelines, and general-purpose enterprise workloads that do not require local NVMe drives.
